_comment: Do NOT add a source here without first checking its terms of use permit automated fetching (many news sites' ToS forbid it even via a public RSS feed) and that WEBLACK has the right relationship to reuse/reference its content. Each entry carries a _verified line recording what was actually checked and when. Three tests are applied before enabling: (1) the feed really parses and carries recent items; (2) robots.txt is parsed per user-agent group — the 'User-agent: *' group must allow the feed path, AND the site must not name-block AI crawlers (GPTBot / ClaudeBot / CCBot), which is an explicit refusal this engine respects even though it is not those crawlers; (3) the feed must carry enough body text to ground facts — a headline-only feed cannot produce a verifiable article and would burn model calls for nothing. Entries that failed any of the three are kept below with enabled:false and the reason, so the same ground is not re-explored on every review.

sources.name: startup-fashion-blog
sources._territory: fashion business — independent designers, brand building
sources._verified: 2026-09-14: real feed fetched successfully (10 items via rss-parser), robots.txt checked (no Disallow on the feed path, no AI-crawler-specific block), no paywall/licensing redirect encountered — matches WEBLACK's 'business créatif' editorial territory.

sources._territory: industrie créative — design, architecture, collaborations mode/design
sources._verified: 2026-09-15: 50 items, newest same-day; robots.txt parsed per group — 'User-agent: *' allows the feed, no GPTBot/ClaudeBot/CCBot block; median item body 4820 characters (full text in feed), enough to ground facts.

sources.name: design-week
sources._verified: 2026-09-15: feed works (20 items, rich content) and 'User-agent: *' allows it, BUT robots.txt name-blocks GPTBot, ClaudeBot and CCBot with Disallow: /. That is an explicit refusal of AI-agent access; not enabled.

sources.name: business-of-fashion
sources._verified: 2026-09-15: rejected on two independent grounds — robots.txt name-blocks GPTBot/ClaudeBot/CCBot with Disallow: /, and the feed carries only paywall teasers (median 135 characters), which cannot ground a single verifiable fact.

sources.name: fashion-ghana
sources._verified: 2026-09-15: feed works (12 items, same-day) and robots.txt allows it, but items carry headline-only bodies (median 93 characters). Nothing can be verified from that, so every article would cost two model calls and be rejected. Re-enable only if the feed starts carrying full text.

_african_fashion_gap: 2026-09-15: African fashion is editorial priority #2 for WEBLACK but no usable automated feed was found. Checked and failed: guzangs.com (HTTP 403 — a refusal, not worked around), nataal.com (404), okayafrica.com (404), fashionunited.africa (DNS does not resolve), africafashionguide.wordpress.com (last post ~2011), thisisafrica.me and designindaba.com (fresh but 462/627-character bodies, too thin to ground facts), fashionghana.com (headline-only, see above). This territory therefore stays on the manual path — npm run editorial:url -- <url> — which is how the Lagos Fashion Week article was produced.
